description: make train's recipe (picoocr_train): the recognizer's alphabet (the classes after CTC's blank - printable ASCII, typographic punctuation, and common Latin accents); the network (model.py - its convolutions [channels, pool], the sequence width, and the residual convolutions' dilations); the training data (render.py and texts.py - the longest text, the font size range in pixels, the mix of text kinds, the validation sets' size and seed); the training (train.py - the batch, the steps, AdamW's learning rate, warmup, and weight decay, the gradient clip, the validation interval, and the seed); and the export (export.py and quant.py - the weights' bits, GPTQ or nearest rounding, and GPTQ's calibration lines - their count and seed, apart from the validation sets').
